title: Unpackable Ice
description: Unpacking recipes for Packed Ice and Blue Ice. Revert them into their base forms in the crafting table.
body:
# Unpackable Ice

A simple and lightweight quality-of-life addition that allows you to unpack and revert compacted Ice blocks back into their base forms, making it easier to store vast amounts of Ice as Packed Ice or Blue Ice without losing the ability to turn them back when needed.

## Crafting Recipes

This adds standard shapeless vanilla unpacking mechanics to the crafting table:

- **1x Packed Ice** -> **9x Ice**
- **1x Blue Ice** -> **9x Packed Ice**
